paragraphs: Qualtrics sells experience management software that collects signals from surveys, calls, digital channels and service interactions. The platform applies automated text analytics to that feedback, surfacing themes, sentiment and risk rather than leaving the responses as raw scores. It also sells research tooling, including synthetic audiences used to test direction, messaging and creative before a launch.

Their pages describe the buyers as global enterprises, healthcare systems and governments. Healthcare organizations are one named market, with patient, member and caregiver signals unified in a single platform. Financial institutions are another, described as getting real-time intelligence across every channel.

A customer story describes Shake Shack using the platform as an end-to-end solution to deliver experiences fueled by customer insights. Another story reports that Samsara selected Qualtrics as its unified voice of customer, employee and partner.

quote.text: The Qualtrics platform allows for quick, scalable analysis that can be easily shared to make fast decisions.
